catalyst.description: The staff or seal, exactly as weapon-lookup resolved it. The ranking is out of this catalyst and changes with it.

upgrade.description: Defaults to the catalyst's own cap, which is what a comparison usually wants.

starting_class.description: Which class the character started as. The ten are listed here rather than only in a precondition, which the routing pack does not publish. Optional: without one the collection uses 'Wretch' — the lowest floors of the ten, so the least distortion — and reports it in `assumed`.

damage_type.description: What the spell deals. 'fire' finds every fire spell whatever school it belongs to — this is the filter for 'best fire incantations'.

family.description: What a catalyst boosts — 'Godslayer', 'Night', 'Dragon Communion'. A different question from damage_type, and the table behind it is the Prometheux ontology's rather than the Build Planner's.

spell_type.description: Narrow to one kind. Usually unnecessary: a catalyst already only casts one.

include_uncastable.description: Keep the spells the build cannot cast, each with its shortfall. Default false.
